forbidden_city.name: Forbidden City
forbidden_city.price_text: CNY 60 peak season (Apr–Oct) · CNY 40 off season · book online in advance
forbidden_city.hours: Tue–Sun roughly 08:30–17:00 · closed Mondays · last entry mid-afternoon
forbidden_city.tip: Book a timed ticket online days ahead with your passport. Enter from the south (Meridian Gate) and exit north into Jingshan Park.
forbidden_city.best: Early morning at opening; avoid weekends and holidays

great_wall.name: Great Wall of China
great_wall.price_text: Entry varies by section (roughly CNY 40–60) · transport extra
great_wall.hours: Daylight hours; sections differ — check on the day
great_wall.tip: Badaling is closest but crowded; Mutianyu is a calmer, greener choice. Go early and wear grippy shoes.
great_wall.best: Morning, spring or autumn for clear, cool weather

summer_palace.name: Summer Palace
summer_palace.price_text: CNY 30 park entry peak · combo ticket with halls costs more
summer_palace.hours: Roughly 06:30–18:00 (later in summer) — check on the day
summer_palace.tip: Walk the Long Corridor along Kunming Lake, then climb to the Tower of Buddhist Incense for the view.

temple_of_heaven.name: Temple of Heaven
temple_of_heaven.price_text: CNY 35 combo ticket (park + halls) · park-only cheaper
temple_of_heaven.hours: Park roughly 06:00–22:00 · halls 08:00–17:00 — check on the day
temple_of_heaven.tip: Come at dawn to see locals doing tai chi and dancing in the park before the halls open.

tiananmen.name: Tiananmen Square
tiananmen.price_text: Free · security check and ID/passport required
tiananmen.hours: Open daily; security queues can be long
tiananmen.tip: Bring your passport and expect bag checks. The flag-raising at sunrise draws big crowds.

birds_nest.name: Bird's Nest (National Stadium)
birds_nest.price_text: Exterior free · interior tour ticket varies — check on the day
birds_nest.hours: Olympic Park open all day · stadium tours vary
birds_nest.tip: Best seen lit up after dark. Combine with the Water Cube next door.

ming_tombs.name: Ming Tombs
ming_tombs.price_text: Entry per tomb (roughly CNY 30–60 each) — check on the day
ming_tombs.tip: The Sacred Way avenue of stone animals is the highlight. Pairs well with a Great Wall day trip.
ming_tombs.best: Morning; combine with the Great Wall

beihai.name: Beihai Park
beihai.price_text: CNY 10 park entry · extra for the White Dagoba island
beihai.tip: Rent a rowing boat on the lake, or climb to the White Dagoba for views over the old city.

blue_zoo.name: Beijing Blue Zoo
blue_zoo.price_text: Ticket price varies — check on the day
blue_zoo.tip: An indoor aquarium-style attraction, good for kids on a hot or rainy day. Confirm opening before you go.

shijingshan.name: Beijing Shijingshan Amusement Park
shijingshan.price_text: Entry plus ride tickets vary — check on the day
shijingshan.tip: A local family amusement park with rides. Buy a combo ticket if you plan several rides.
shijingshan.best: Weekday; summer and holidays are busy

beijing_zoo.name: Beijing Zoo
beijing_zoo.price_text: Entry roughly CNY 15–20 · panda house extra — check on the day
beijing_zoo.tip: Go early to see the giant pandas active before the crowds and heat arrive.

cctv.name: CCTV Headquarters
cctv.price_text: Free to view from outside · no public interior access
cctv.hours: Viewable any time from the street
cctv.tip: The famous 'big trousers' tower. Best photographed from the CBD streets at dusk.

champion_pizza.name: Champion Pizza
champion_pizza.price_text: Pizza roughly CNY 60–120 — check on the day
champion_pizza.hours: Varies by branch — check on the day
champion_pizza.tip: A casual pizza spot popular with locals and expats. Confirm the branch and hours before going.

china_zun.name: China Zun (CITIC Tower)
china_zun.price_text: Free to view from outside · observation access limited
china_zun.hours: Viewable any time from the street
china_zun.tip: Beijing's tallest tower, shaped like an ancient wine vessel. See it from the CBD at night.

cotti_coffee.name: Cotti Coffee
cotti_coffee.price_text: Coffee roughly CNY 15–35 — check on the day
cotti_coffee.hours: Varies by branch — check on the day
cotti_coffee.tip: A fast-growing Chinese coffee chain with cheap drinks. Order via app; branches are everywhere.

drum_bell.name: Drum and Bell Towers
drum_bell.price_text: Combined ticket roughly CNY 30 — check on the day
drum_bell.tip: Climb the steep stairs for rooftop views over the hutongs. Drum performances happen at intervals.
drum_bell.best: Late afternoon, then wander the hutongs

happy_valley.name: Happy Valley (Beijing)
happy_valley.price_text: Day ticket roughly CNY 200–300 — check on the day
happy_valley.tip: A big theme park with roller coasters. Go on a weekday and check ride closures online.

jingshan.name: Jingshan Park
jingshan.tip: Climb to the Wanchun Pavilion for the classic view over the Forbidden City's golden roofs.

lama_temple.name: Lama Temple (Yonghegong)
lama_temple.tip: A working Tibetan Buddhist temple with a huge standing Buddha. Dress respectfully and go early.

mi_bibimbap.name: Mi Bibimbap
mi_bibimbap.price_text: Bowls roughly CNY 30–60 — check on the day
mi_bibimbap.hours: Varies by branch — check on the day
mi_bibimbap.tip: A quick Korean rice-bowl chain, handy for a cheap lunch. Confirm the branch near you.

mutianyu_cable.name: Mutianyu Great Wall Cable Car
mutianyu_cable.price_text: Cable car roughly CNY 100–140 return — check on the day
mutianyu_cable.tip: The cable car saves a steep climb. You can ride up and take the toboggan down for fun.

ghost_market.name: Panjiayuan Antique Market
ghost_market.price_text: Free to enter · bring cash for bargains
ghost_market.hours: Roughly 08:30–18:00 · busiest at weekends — check on the day
ghost_market.tip: Haggle hard for crafts, Mao memorabilia and antiques. Weekend mornings have the most stalls.

hutong_walk.name: Houhai and hutong walk
hutong_walk.hours: Any time; liveliest in the evening
hutong_walk.tip: Wander the lanes around Houhai lake, then stop for snacks and people-watching at dusk.

peking_duck.name: Peking duck dinner
peking_duck.price_text: Whole duck roughly CNY 200–400 — check on the day
peking_duck.tip: Book a table at a well-known duck restaurant. Watch it carved tableside and wrap it in pancakes.

wangfujing.name: Wangfujing Street
wangfujing.price_text: Free to walk · snacks and shopping extra
wangfujing.tip: A busy pedestrian shopping street with snack stalls. Good for an easy evening stroll.

olympic_park.name: Olympic Park evening walk
olympic_park.hours: Open all day; best after dark
olympic_park.tip: Walk between the Bird's Nest and Water Cube when both are lit up. Bring a jacket in cooler months.

p798.name: 798 Art Zone
p798.price_text: Free to wander · individual galleries may charge
p798.hours: Most galleries roughly 10:00–18:00 · many closed Mondays
p798.tip: A former factory district full of galleries, cafés and street art. Go on a weekday afternoon.
